## About
Lawn Works Landscaping is owned by Hernan Cadena III. Hernan is a native Texan, born and raised in Del Rio, who came to San Antonio to attend The University of Texas at San Antonio. His studies and part time work in the landscaping industry led him to open Lawn Works.
We work with homeowners, businesses, custom and tract home builders, real estate agencies and property management companies. We specialize in new home landscaping and irrigation as well as existing landscape design and maintenance.
Hernan is also a partner in a sports complex that keeps the Lawn Works crew busy with lawn maintenance, and he holds a Real Estate license. As he puts it, that mix of real estate, sports field management and landscape construction helps him give customers the best overall service.

## Services
- Landscape Design and Installation: Planning and building new landscapes, from new home yards to updates on existing ones.
- Complete Landscape Maintenance: Ongoing care to keep a yard or property looking the way it should.
- Irrigation System Installs and Service: New sprinkler systems and service on the ones you already have.
- Sod Installation and Delivery: Fresh sod delivered and laid. One reviewer said Hernan took the time to explain how to care for newly installed sod.
- Dry stack retaining walls and flagstone walkways: Stonework for walls and walkways. One reviewer called the flagstone and excavation work exceptional.
- Tree and Shrub Installation and Delivery: Trees and shrubs brought out and planted.
- Outdoor Lighting Installation: Lighting for yards, paths and landscaped areas.
- Builder and General Contractor Partnerships: Landscaping and irrigation for new construction, working alongside local and national builders.

## FAQ
Q: Who do you work with?
A: Residential homeowners, commercial and industrial businesses, custom home builders, tract home builders, real estate agencies and property management companies.

Q: What areas do you serve?
A: San Antonio and the surrounding areas.

Q: What if I don't see the service I need?
A: Just give us a call. We'll be happy to talk through your plans and let you know how we can help.

Q: What are your hours?
A: Monday through Friday, 8:00 AM to 5:00 PM, and Saturday, 9:00 AM to 2:00 PM. We're closed Sunday.
